theorems.statement: ∀ (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] (a : ι → A), (∃ i, a i ≠ 0) → ∃ i, a i ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ j, a i ∣ a j
theorems.natural_summary: Factor each nonzero entry as a unit times a power of a fixed uniformizer. Choose an entry attaining the minimum exponent on the finite nonempty support. Its power divides every other power, unit factors preserve divisibility, and it also divides every zero entry.
